effects.title: Basic Attack
effects.description:
Melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun, memberikan  Fusion DMG.
Setelah menggunakan Basic Attack 4, masuk ke True Sight selama 12 detik.

effects.title: Heavy Attack
effects.description:
Tahan Basic Attack saat berada di tanah untuk melakukan tebasan ke atas dengan mengorbankan Stamina, memberikan  Fusion DMG
Gunakan Basic Attack dalam waktu tertentu untuk mengaktifkan Mid-air Attack 3.

effects.title: Mid-air Attack
effects.description:
Menggunakan Stamina untuk melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun di udara, memberikan  Fusion DMG.
Setelah menggunakan Mid-air Attack 4, masuk ke True Sight selama 12 detik.

effects.title: Mid-air Heavy Attack
effects.description:
Sesaat setelah menahan Basic Attack di udara atau menggunakan Basic Attack True Sight: Charge, gunakan Basic Attack untuk melakukan serangan jatuh dengan mengorbankan Stamina, memberikan  Fusion DMG.
Gunakan Basic Attack dalam waktu tertentu untuk mengaktifkan Basic Attack 3.

effects.title: Dodge Counter
effects.description: Gunakan Basic Attack setelah berhasil menghindar (Dodge) untuk menyerang target, memberikan  Fusion DMG.

effects.title: True Sight: Capture
effects.description:
Saat menggunakan Resonance Skill, Changli melesat ke arah musuh dan memasuki True Sight selama 12 detik. Setelahnya, ia melakukan Plunge ATK yang memberikan  Fusion DMG.
True Sight: Capture memiliki 2 initial charges dan dapat menyimpan hingga 2 Maksimum charges.
charges akan bertambah 1 setiap 12 detik.
Dapat digunakan di udara.

effects.title: Basic Attack: True Sight - Conquest
effects.description: Saat berada dalam True Sight,jika Changli menggunakan Ground Basic Attack, ia akan melepaskan True Sight: Conquest, melesat ke arah musuh dan memberikan  Fusion DMG yang dihitung sebagai Resonance Skill DMG. Setelah menggunakannya, True Sight berakhir.

effects.title: Basic Attack: True Sight - Charge
effects.description: Saat berada dalam True Sight, jika Changli melompat atau menggunakan Basic Attack di udara, ia akan melepaskan True Sight: Charge melesat ke arah musuh dan memberikan  Fusion DMG yang dihitung sebagai Resonance Skill DMG. Setelah menggunakannya, True Sight berakhir.
Memberikan  Fusion DMG ke target di sekitar, mendapatkan 4 stacks Enflamement, dan memasuki Fiery Feather.
Dapat digunakan di udara.

effects.title: Fiery Feather
effects.description: Saat Changli menggunakan Heavy Attack: Flaming Sacrifice dalam 10 detik, ATK meningkat 25%, lalu Fiery Feather berakhir.

effects.title: Heavy Attack: Flaming Sacrifice
effects.description:
Saat menggunakan Heavy Attack, jika Changli memiliki 4 stack(s) Enflamement, ia akan menghabiskan semua stack(s) tersebut untuk melepaskan Flaming Sacrifice, memberikan  Fusion DMG yang dihitung sebagai Resonance Skill DMG.
Saat menggunakan Flaming Sacrifice, Changli menerima 40% lebih sedikit DMG.

effects.title: Enflamement
effects.description:
Changli dapat menyimpan hingga 4 stack(s) Enflamement.
Mendapatkan 1 stack(s) Enflamementsetiap kali Basic Attack: True Sight: Conquest mengenai target.
Mendapatkan 1 stack(s) Enflamement setiap kali Basic Attack: True Sight: Charge mengenai target.
Mendapatkan 4 tstack(s) Enflamement setiap kali menggunakan Resonance Liberation: Radiance of Fealty.
Saat Changli menggunakan Basic Attack: True Sight: Conquest atau Basic Attack: True Sight: Charge, untuk setiap stack(s) Enflamement,  Fusion DMG Bonus meningkat 5%.
Menggunakan Heavy Attack: Flaming Sacrifice atau Resonance Liberation: Radiance of Fealty memberikan 20%  Fusion DMG Bonus dan mengabaikan 15% DEF musuh saat memberikan serangan.
Changli muncul di udara, menyerang target, lalu memasuki True Sight selama 12 detik.
Resonator yang masuk akan mendapatkan 20%  Fusion DMG Amplification dan 25% Resonance Liberation DMG Amplification selama 10 detik atau hingga mereka diganti.
Resonance Skill: Tripartite Flames dan Heavy Attack: Flaming Sacrifice meningkatkan DMG yang dihasilkan oleh Changli sebesar 10% serta meningkatkan ketahanan terhadap gangguan saat menyerang.
Setiap Enflamement meningkatkan Crit. Rate Changli sebesar 25% selama 8 detik.
Resonance Liberation: Radiance of Fealty mendapatkan peningkatan DMG sebesar 80%.
Setelah menggunakan Intro Skill, ATK seluruh anggota tim meningkat 20% selama 30 detik.
Multiplier dari Heavy Attack: Flaming Sacrifice meningkat 50%, dan DMG yang dihasilkan juga meningkat 50%.
Resonance Skill: Tripartite Flames, Heavy Attack: Flaming Sacrifice dan Resonance Liberation: Radiance of Fealty mengabaikan tambahan 40% dari DEF musuh saat memberikan serangan.

Changli is a counselor serving the Jinzhou Magistrate, and former Secretary-General in the capital.
Shrouded in flames, she's fated to burn brightly until her final embers.
With her fiery determination and strategic mindset, she rises to power, always thinking ahead to reach her ultimate goal.

TalentDoc.Title: Resonance Evaluation Report
TalentDoc.Content:
Evaluation Basis: [Resonance Assessment 2326-G]

The precise timing of Resonator Changli's Awakening remains uncertain. Reports indicate that Resonator Changli displayed early signs of fire manipulation during her childhood, often struggling to control it. However, as Changli matured into adulthood, the frequency and stability of these manifestations notably improved.

Resonator Changli's Tacet Mark is situated on her lower chest. Post-Awakening examinations have identified specific alterations in her physical attributes. These include a gradual fading of hair color at the tips and feather-like burn marks on her left arm, emitting a fiery glow influenced by her Forte.

The Resonance Spectrum Pattern of Changli mirrors the characteristics of fire, displaying a robust Syntony reaction in testing. Despite the exact trigger for her Awakening remaining uncertain, no other sample with a Resonance Spectrum Pattern similarity exceeding 60% has been identified. Resonator Changli's Forte aligns closely with the mythical spirit bird from Huanglong folklore, possibly influenced by her early immersion in tales related to this legendary creature.

Resonator Changli possesses the unique ability to compress flames into delicate feather-shaped projectiles. Her Forte, once unleashed, has the power to create scorching fires of exceptional heat, capable of devastating a large area. A telltale sign that her Forte is active is the emergence of a lone fiery feather with an eye-like pattern on her forehead, which she describes as the "Mind's Eye."

Analysis of test samples has revealed a non-convergent Rabelle's Curve with a stable rise. Occasional fluctuations within normal range have been detected. Therefore, Changli is identified as a Natural Resonator.

TalentCertification.Title: Overclock Diagnostic Report
TalentCertification.Content:
Resonator Changli's waveform graph shows elliptical fluctuations. The pattern of Time Domain is stable, with no abnormal waveform.

Resonant Criticality: High. Resonator Changli's frequency displays high stability, and the risk of Overclocking is minimal.
Resonator Changli has a documented history of Overclocking.
Maximum Overclocking rating: Negligible.

According to Changli's report, she experienced Overclocking during her childhood due to prolonged exposure to a hazardous environment. This caused her Forte to go into an explosive state multiple times for self-preservation or the protection of others, resulting in a permanent burn mark on her left arm.

However, as she grew up and gained more control over her Forte, the frequency fluctuation stabilized and the burn mark did not worsen. There may be irreversible physical damage from the Forte burst, which could potentially shorten Resonator Changli's lifespan.

Regular physical check-ups are recommended, while psychological counseling is not currently necessary.
